title: Evidence for Chapter 35: the West German currency reform of 1948, the Marshall Plan, Japan from the frozen deposits of 1946 to the Dodge Line, Britain's post-war credits, the Soviet reform of 1947 and the gold yuan
source: Buchheim, 'Die Waehrungsreform 1948 in Westdeutschland' (Vierteljahrshefte fuer Zeitgeschichte 36, 1988), Ritschl, 'Die Waehrungsreform von 1948 und der Wiederaufstieg der westdeutschen Industrie' (VfZ 33, 1985, with Tab. I read on the page image) and Abelshauser, 'Wiederaufbau vor dem Marshall-Plan' (VfZ 29, 1981), the PDFs of the Institut fuer Zeitgeschichte; the Waehrungsgesetz, Umstellungsgesetz and Festkontogesetz of 1948 and the law establishing the Bank deutscher Laender (Military Government laws nos. 61, 63, 65 and 60), the texts of verfassungen.de; the Monatsberichte der Bank deutscher Laender of February 1950 (the Deutsche Bundesbank's archive; the labour-market table read on the page image) and the Bundesbank's terms of use; De Long and Eichengreen, NBER Working Paper 3899 (1991); Marshall's remarks at Harvard (Department of State Bulletin, 15 June 1947); the Economic Cooperation Act of 1948 (62 Stat. 137); Foreign Relations of the United States 1948 vol. VI (doc. 696), 1948 vol. VIII (docs. 333, 340, 343, 359, 364, 368, 372) and 1949 vol. VII part 2 (docs. 67, 161); the Ministry of Finance's Fiscal and Monetary Policies of Japan 1945-1971, Part 1, Chapters 1 and 2, and its terms of use; the Centennial History of the Bank of Japan, vol. 5 (1985), four sections read on the page images, the Bank's chronology and its copyright page; the decision of the USSR Council of Ministers and the Central Committee of 14 December 1947 in Zaria Vostoka no. 247 (page image) and in the excerpt of Vestnik Universiteta imeni O. E. Kutafina (2025); House of Commons Hansard, 15 April 1959, 18 January 1972 (written answers) and 9 March 1972; Wang Yunwu's statement of 19 August 1948 (Chinese Wikisource); the authority records of the Library of Congress and of the Deutsche Nationalbibliothek (through lobid.org)
series: Evidence rows: id, place, year, values (';' separated, in the order of the quotation), unit, source key, page or section, the source text verbatim, note
license: Quotations for criticism, scholarship and teaching, each with its source; no full original is redistributed. Buchheim (1988), Ritschl (1985) and Abelshauser (1981): each page of the Institut fuer Zeitgeschichte's PDFs reads '©Vierteljahrshefte für Zeitgeschichte' (rows bu_copyright, ri_copyright, ab_copyright); the authors' words are quoted in short phrases only and the rest is paraphrased, with '% 据:' anchors in the chapter. De Long and Eichengreen (1991), NBER Working Paper 3899: the PDF prints no copyright notice; short phrases only, with full credit to the authors and the NBER. The laws of the Military Governments of 1948 (nos. 60, 61, 63 and 65) are official works (amtliche Werke, section 5 of the German Urheberrechtsgesetz); the edition used is the text of verfassungen.de named in each source. Bank deutscher Laender, Monatsberichte, February 1950, from the Deutsche Bundesbank's archive: the Bundesbank's terms of use read 'Die etwaigen oben aufgeführten Verwertungshandlungen Weitergabe und Vervielfältigung der von der Deutschen Bundesbank erstellten Informationen haben unter der folgenden Angabe zu erfolgen: „Quelle: Deutsche Bundesbank"' and 'Die Informationen dürfen nicht verändert oder verfälscht werden.' (rows bbk_terms, bbk_unaltered). Marshall's remarks as Secretary of State (Department of State Bulletin), the Economic Cooperation Act of 1948 (Statutes at Large) and Foreign Relations of the United States are works of the United States government and in the public domain; Dodge's statement is quoted only through the Bank of Japan's summary. Ministry of Finance, Japan: '掲載・発信している情報の著作権は、特記されていない限り財務省に帰属し、権利表記の記載がない限り「公共データ利用規約(第1.0版)」(PDL1.0)【デジタル庁ホームページ】が適用されています。' and 'Copyright © Ministry of Finance Japan. All Rights Reserved.' (rows mof_terms, mof_copyright); the source is credited as the Ministry of Finance. Bank of Japan (the Centennial History, the chronology): 'The information included in the site may be copied or reproduced with the exceptions below. When copying or reproducing, the source, the Bank of Japan, should be explicitly credited.' (row bojcr_terms); credit: Bank of Japan. The Centennial History (Nihon Ginko hyakunenshi, 1982-86) is the Bank's copyright work: short quotations only. The decision of the USSR Council of Ministers and the Central Committee of 14 December 1947 is an official act of state, not protected by copyright; the editions used are Zaria Vostoka no. 247 of 15 December 1947 (the scan of the National Parliamentary Library of Georgia) and the excerpt in Vestnik Universiteta imeni O. E. Kutafina (2025). Wang Yunwu's statement of 1948 is a public document of the Republic of China's Ministry of Finance; Wikisource marks it public domain under article 9 of the Copyright Act of the Republic of China: '中華民國《著作權法》:第九條(著作權標的之限制)下列各款不得為著作權之標的:一、憲法、法律、命令或公文。' (row ww_pd); the edition used is Wikisource revision 2108829. Hansard: 'Contains Parliamentary information licensed under the Open Parliament Licence v3.0.' The pages read '© UK Parliament' (row h_copyright). The authority records of the Library of Congress (id.loc.gov) are public data; the records of the Deutsche Nationalbibliothek (GND, through lobid.org) are under 'http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/' (row gnd_licence). The chapter's Chinese renders the quotations; the translations are the book's.
citation: See the 'source' field; each row names its source key in the 'sources' object.
notes: Every quotation is checked word for word against the cached source text by data/fetch/verify_web_quotes.py, and every value is read from its quotation by checks/check_ch35.py; rows with an empty quotation are words or figures read on a page image (sources ritschl1985img, bdl1950img, boj1985a-d, ussr1947zv), named as such in their notes, which give a transcription between « and ». The pages of verfassungen.de are encoded in ISO-8859-1 and read as UTF-8, so their quotations are fragments without umlauts ('nfhundertvierzig' is the end of 'fünfhundertvierzig'). The OCR of the Monatsberichte reads '~st' for 'ist' (bdl_stall) and 'V er kehr' (bdl_kfw); the text layer of the Ministry of Finance's chapter runs 'June' and 'August' together (mof_rfbbuy) and keeps the page number '- 30 -' inside a sentence (mof_wagerules); Hansard reads 'w II' for 'will' (h59_newages); the OCR of Buchheim's article reads 'Ritschi' for 'Ritschl' (bu_ritschl). Disagreements between the sources: verfassungen.de dates the Umstellungsgesetz 20 June 1948, Buchheim 27 June (ug_title, bu_ug_date); the Ministry of Finance dates the outbreak of the Korean War July 1950, the Bank of Japan 25 June 1950 (mof_korea, bj_korea); the Ministry's text calls ¥135,751 million the free accounts of March 1946, while its Table 1-9 gives that figure as the total and ¥14,518 million as the free accounts (mof_frozen46, mof_table46); on the rate of 360 yen, the Ministry says that SCAP floated ¥300 or ¥400 and decided on ¥360 in March 1949, the Bank of Japan that Dodge and SCAP proposed ¥330 and the National Advisory Council in Washington strongly recommended ¥360 on 29 March, which Dodge then adopted (mof_300, mof_360, bj_330plan, bj_nac360, bj_dodge360); the chapter follows the Bank of Japan. Indirect testimony: the annex of the Leitsaetzegesetz, the CDG plan (in Buchheim's German), Tenenbaum's words at Rothwesten and Röpke's article through Buchheim; the black-market prices of Hamburg in May 1948 through Buchheim, who draws on Mendershausen; Manz's and Abelshauser's estimates and Wallich's view through Ritschl; Milward through De Long and Eichengreen; Dodge's statement of 7 March 1949 through the Bank of Japan's summary of its points; the National Advisory Council's recommendation of 29 March 1949 through the Bank of Japan's history; Abelshauser's half-year growth of production before and after the reform (Abelshauser's book of 1975) through Buchheim (bu_19); Chiang Ching-kuo's speech through the North China Daily News as the consulate general at Shanghai reported it. Not obtained: Dodge's 'stilts' remark (the CIA reading room refused access), Wallich (1955), Milward (1984), Abelshauser (1975), Manz's thesis, the sources on the general strike of 12 November 1948 and on cigarette money, the exact dates of the Soviet zone's currency reform and of the Berlin blockade, and Jenkin's dates (in neither authority file). Erhard's role as the issuer of the price order of 25 June 1948 is inferred from the title of his speech (Abelshauser, note 74) and Buchheim's account. The record of the Deutsche Nationalbibliothek for Amory is taken to be the Chancellor's by his name and dates. Ritschl and Buchheim are not independent witnesses: Ritschl thanks Buchheim for the hints to the argument that follows his note 60 (ri_fn60), and Buchheim's case against Abelshauser's estimate rests on Ritschl's analysis (bu_ritschl); the chapter names this in its 史料说明.
